overall_assessment:
The automated candidate satisfies this lane's architecture-adherence and affected-security prerequisite. No new actionable material finding is established by the bounded package. This is an independent package-only assessment: I did not execute commands, recompute hashes, or treat executor/root conclusions as independent approval. Local-Implemented delivery remains pending.

The current explicit APROVADO v1.3 governs the narrow managed-index and CI additions. Historical pending-approval wording does not override that approval. The additions are part of the renewed baseline, not temporary architectural exceptions. Architecture Change Governance permits no temporary exceptions; none is identified in the supplied implementation.

| Decision | Assessment | Evidence and applicable limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D-01 | Adherent | channel.ts defines an abstract Channel with opaque recipientRef and a discriminated result. Explicit factories create operation-bound adapters. ConversationsService, IncomingService and OutboundService contain no provider-client dispatch. Existing consumer text limits remain outside the universal port. |
| D-02 | Adherent | BFF session/CSRF and BU-role authorization, public key/account scope, and verified bot ingress remain distinct authority sources. Resolver references are derived server-side. Credential resolution checks current owned identity and encrypted credentials; public operation context excludes tokens and protocol addresses. Availability grants no authority. |
| D-03 | Adherent | The frozen context captures BU/channel/identity/generation/epoch/credential version. Shipping adapters invoke the local pre-dispatch callback; failures block before provider calls. Post-dispatch checks and MessageAcceptance retain the captured identity. Real REAUTORIZAR and version-only rotation have separate probes. The acknowledged local-check-to-network race remains within the approved limitation. |
| D-04 | Adherent | Meta validates the single-message acknowledgement and contradictory success/error indicators; definitive refusal uses the approved narrow allowlist. Evolution failures remain UNKNOWN, arbitrary successful objects are unconfirmed, and supported key:{} remains ACK_WITHOUT_ID. Text clients issue one POST with timeout and redirect rejection, without retry or extra grant probes. |
| D-05 | Adherent | OutboundService distinguishes confirmed diagnostic persistence, uncertain persistence, context retirement, transport uncertainty and known external acceptance followed by local failure. Readback is bounded and uses captured provenance. Local failures do not become external refusal; UI retains drafts and Typebot stops without replay. |
| D-06 | Adherent | One OutboundService serves BFF/public/bot and delegates keyed Message persistence/reconciliation to the existing MessageAcceptanceService. Public send completion no longer writes attribution directly. Conditional current-owner finalization preserves concurrent claims; bot completion preserves queue/owner/unread semantics. No second acceptance owner or durable intent is introduced. |
| D-07 | Adherent | Latest origin uses database createdAt/id ordering; missing, ambiguous and unavailable selections do not fall back. Bot dispatch remains pinned to verified ingress and checks the selected window for each output. Public availability uses batched metadata and selected-window history only. The approved managed index supports whole-history latest-IN, including expired/no-IN/tie cases. Public list/thread limits now remain positive and bounded. |
| D-08 | Adherent | The independent opaque-recipient Channel fake traverses registry/resolver/BFF/acceptance without provider calls. The physical origin slots and public numeric-phone contract remain deliberately unchanged. No real future network, template capability or speculative lifecycle implementation appears. |
| D-09 | Adherent | BFF/Public/Webhooks import the same transport composition module and retain separate authentication. The dependency harness checks common consumers and includes synthetic forbidden coupling. Registration/protocol client use remains legitimate; no parallel legacy send path or compatibility shim is identified. |
| D-10 | Adherent for the automated prerequisite | api.ts preserves safe uncertainty metadata; Inbox exposes availability, retains drafts and fences late completions. The shared runner uses positive source inventories, disposable resources and mandatory validation commands. CI admission, Linux execution and the remediated guard are evidenced. Physical IN/OUT, consolidation and final delivery obligations remain explicitly pending in their approved order. |

The supplied constitution and module baseline remain consistent with the candidate: conversations belong to BU/contact; surface authentication stays separate; business policy remains in the backend; credentials remain scoped and private; keyed acceptance remains singular. The consolidation draft accurately describes the intended owners and limitations without claiming that canonical modules have already been updated. ST-CON-05/04 remain handoffs requiring their own contracts.

The reported current broad execution is canonical-linux-all28261: CHANNELS_DOCKER_TRANSPORT=linux bash scripts/test-channels-local.sh all, exit 0, with 194 API unit, 315 PostgreSQL, 29 Web unit and 50 Chromium tests, totaling 588. Its raw-log SHA256 is e904bf3203be423666c9428e262e9e51c46e263c22570d71c1f9d3cd6ee3d25e. Evidence distinguishes Node 22.23.3/disposable PostgreSQL 16 and actual Linux transport on the verified shared Docker engine from remote GitHub execution. The 38 browser source records and served/dist/preserved bundle identity support current browser provenance.

The source statement is correctly limited to 60 unchanged public product/context paths. The remaining snapshotted path was the governing TODO, whose reported pre-run and post-run hashes differ. Its separately documented reconstruction classifies progress metadata changes without changing frozen Scope/DoD/decisions/Approval or an executable input. This does not establish a 61/61 match and does not justify reusing old all2564 evidence. The canonical invalidation decision remains manual-admission-required; the separate authority record admits a fresh all under the approved working-tree contract rather than relabeling historical evidence as reusable.

The current test changes reflect real approved obligations. Pagination has two separated pre-fix endpoint failures followed by passing real HTTP/Prisma/PostgreSQL tests. The Prisma spies forward to the original delegates and restore in finally; they observe query bounds rather than replace datastore results. Public availability assertions cover available/null and unavailable/reason projections on both GETs, plus authoritative POST refusal with unchanged provider counters and no new OUT despite an alternative ready channel. Availability coverage is honestly test-after for already-correct behavior. SEC13-01 evidence is explicitly post-fix causal omission evidence, not fabricated test-first history. No new pass-the-test shortcut is apparent.

Performance evidence supports the bounded architecture claim: the actual latest-IN plan includes conversation and direction equality in the approved index condition, 500 probes, zero OUT rows removed by filter and 1003 shared-hit blocks. Selected non-window references issue zero window queries; the public-page probe records one binding, one credential-metadata and one window-projection query. The migration matches the named Prisma index and exact transactional 5s/60s settings. Accelerated 55P03/57014 failure probes demonstrate rollback separately from those configured limits. The approximately 6.86 MB index and 1000-row write samples of approximately 15.89 ms with versus 6.47 ms without the index are descriptive costs, not capacity or timing guarantees. EPS-E2, FRC 20x5, BCI 20x5 with per-owned-row readback, and bounded RLS-E1 candidates provide the declared evidence profiles; their formal independent dispositions remain separate pending gates. Distinct-conversation overlap is not external same-key exactly-once proof.

Security risk remains high because this slice crosses tenant, credential and external-side-effect boundaries. Attack simulation is required. The supplied controlled simulations substantiate the affected automated boundaries: missing session/CSRF/grant and foreign public-account mutations are denied before dispatch; concurrent tenants retain distinct token/resource and persisted-message provenance; foreign or retired ingress cannot rebind; real adapter callback probes cover version/generation/epoch changes; real reauthorization differs from credential-only rotation; malformed/contradictory provider acknowledgements do not create authoritative success. Parameterized queries, bounded pagination, encoded protocol resource paths, redirect rejection and fixed safe errors constrain the relevant query, request and outcome boundaries. No agent/prompt-execution surface is introduced. No demonstrated tenant breakout or credential disclosure is established by this package.

SEC13-01 is resolved for its concrete protection obligation. The current validator requires standalone common-guard/E2E commands and set -eu. Both actual command-plus-||true mutations are rejected among 23 negatives. Removing the two checks in memory accepts those mutations, establishing their causal contribution. Separately, the actual shared RUNNER_SCRIPT runs through fake Docker with fake prerequisites; the mandatory Python guard returns 42, the outer wrapper returns 42, and down is observed. That proves the specified failure propagation/cleanup path without invoking a real daemon/provider. It is bounded executable protection, not universal shell verification, proof of every leaf failure, or protection against deleting every enforcement invocation.

R01/R03/R05 remain closed: the supplied classifiers retain their corrected envelope behavior. R04 retains actual shipping-adapter omission/restoration evidence. R02 retains the native-body-settlement/following-task barrier, actual generation-guard omission failure, exact restoration and distinct served-bundle provenance; current api.ts/Inbox continuations support that synchronization argument. No changed locus or concrete regression warrants reopening them.

No fresh external threat-intelligence retrieval was performed under the explicit no-tools constraint. Supplied provider-reference history is background, not a new verification of current provider policy or dependency advisories. Security conclusions are limited to the supplied source and controlled attack evidence.

The proposed local activation preserves the approved boundary: source-bound positive build inputs; only the named index on the preserved local test database; stop and inspect transactional/catalog/migration state on failure; API/Web-only recreation; effective configuration retained privately in memory; existing storage, channels, credentials and non-target services preserved; source-to-image-to-container-to-HTTP freshness checked. HTTPS restoration and callback coordination do not authorize re-registration or credential rotation. These are acceptable preparation boundaries, not completed operational evidence.

Remote CI remains not_run without being converted into a local prerequisite waiver. Preserved database migration, candidate API/Web activation, restored HTTPS and fresh operator official/unofficial IN/OUT remain OrderedStep6 after all automated prerequisites converge. TQA-R02-02 continues to block Local-Implemented until that proof exists. Canonical module consolidation, final assurance and closeout remain required afterward. Confidence is sufficient for this bounded automated prerequisite; live-provider behavior, operational preservation and final delivery are still unverified.
recommended_path: Accept this architecture-adherence and affected-security automated-candidate prerequisite, including the bounded SEC13-01 remediation. Preserve R01–R05 resolutions. After the other required automated reviews and PCV dispositions converge, proceed through approved OrderedStep6, then module consolidation and final delivery gates.
